preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 1000 and 2 <= M <= 1000 for N, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the dimensions N and M of the grid are between 2 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(B) == N * M for (N, M), B in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the array B is equal to N * M.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(B)) == len(B) for _, B in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, all elements in the array B are distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= B_i <= 10**9 for _, B in test_cases for B_i in B)
preconditions.description: For each test case, all elements in the array B are between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: sum(N * M for (N, M), _ in test_cases) <= 10**6
preconditions.description: The sum of N * M over all test cases does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: all(len(grid) == N and all(len(row) == M for row in grid) for (N, M), grid in test_case_grids)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the grid has dimensions N x M.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(B)) == len(set(flatten(grid))) for (_, B), grid in zip(test_cases, test_case_grids) for flatten in [lambda grid: [item for row in grid for item in row]])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the grid contains the same distinct elements as the array B.

postconditions.expression: all(is_minimal_score(grid) for (N, M), grid in test_case_grids)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the grid is arranged such that the score of the grid is minimized.
